Screenshots

This kit does not add new screenshots. It reuses the captures that already document the product under docs/assets/screenshots/. Do not recreate, retouch, or edit a finding count into one of these files; if a post needs a current capture, regenerate it from the same command and say what changed.

File What it shows Best for
html-report.webp Self-contained HTML report from examples/demo, with finding counts and a high-severity deprecated package X, Bluesky, thread, general newsletters
job-summary.webp GitHub Actions job summary with severity counts and a finding table LinkedIn, DevOps and platform newsletters, r/devops
pr-comment.webp Pull request comment from the Action with the gate result and finding rows r/devops, CI-focused newsletters
sarif-alert.webp GitHub code scanning alert opened from Offing SARIF r/devops follow-up, security or code-scanning sections
treemap.webp Findings treemap sized by severity-weighted count and colored by highest severity Mastodon, visual or data-oriented newsletters

Capture details

HTML report

  • It is the output of offing scan --format html on examples/demo, and it says so in the header: scanned locally, no network, no external assets.
  • The visible finding is the deprecated request package at package.json:8, with its rule, replacement, event, source, and verify command.
  • Alt text: Offing HTML report from the demo project, showing three findings with a high-severity deprecated package, its file location, replacement, and source.

GitHub Actions job summary

  • Shows the severity gate result, counts for high, medium, and low, and rows for a deprecated package, an unsupported Action runtime, and an end-of-life runtime.
  • Alt text: GitHub Actions job summary from Offing showing two high and one medium finding, with file locations and evidence labels.

Pull request comment

  • Shows the same kind of result as a pull request comment, with links to the exact file locations and a note that the scan is local.
  • Alt text: Offing pull request comment listing a deprecated package and an unsupported Action runtime, with file locations and a gate result.

Code scanning alert

  • Shows a SARIF finding in GitHub code scanning with the rule, location, replacement, ordered steps, and the source note.
  • Alt text: GitHub code scanning alert titled "request is deprecated" with the rule, file location, replacement, and verification steps.

Findings treemap

  • The legend explains the sizing (critical 8, high 4, medium 2, low 1, info 0.5) and the color (highest severity in the file).
  • Alt text: Treemap of Offing findings by file, sized by severity-weighted finding count and colored by the highest severity in each file.

Counts can differ

The captures show an earlier state of examples/demo. A current scan can report a different number of findings because the bundled rules change between releases, and the demo documentation has described four and five findings at different times. Do not quote the number in the image as a product metric. If a post needs an exact count, run a fresh scan and recapture instead of editing the image.

Refreshing a capture

Use the same commands the documentation uses, then replace the file at the same path so existing links keep working.

npm run build
demo="$(node dist/tools/examples.js demo)"
node dist/src/cli.js scan "$demo" --format html > report.html

For the treemap, use the treemap section of the same HTML report. The Action screenshots require a workflow run; the captures under docs/assets/screenshots/ are the approved ones, so reuse them rather than staging a fake run.

If a capture changes, update its alt text here and check the pages that already embed it: MCP.md, GITHUB_ACTION.md, and SHARE_REPORT.md.
